name: Citalopram
summary: Citalopram is an SSRI that is used to treat depression. It does not lead to a high and causes a wide range of negative psychological and physical effects when people attempt to abuse it. These include nausea, serotonin syndrome, and suicidal ideation. Those with bipolar disorder tend to go into a mixed state or manic states when trying SSRI's.

pharmacology.text: Citalopram contains two pharmacodynamically distinct enantiomers: (S)-citalopram (escitalopram) and (R)-citalopram. (S)-citalopram is a highly selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor and is thought to be responsible for most of the SRI activity of citalopram. (R)-citalopram, by comparison, is a 20-fold less potent SERT inhibitor and antagonizes the actions of (S)-citalopram at this site.

body.says: Mostly as unmetabolized citalopram, partly DCT, and traces of DDCT in urine

uses.text: Citalopram, sold under the brand name Celexa among others, is an antidepressant of the selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) class. It is used to treat major depressive disorder, obsessive–compulsive disorder, panic disorder, and social anxiety disorder. It is typically taken orally (swallowed by mouth).

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include nausea, trouble sleeping, sexual problems, shakiness, feeling tired, and sweating. Serious side effects include an increased risk of suicide in those under the age of 25, serotonin syndrome, glaucoma, and QT prolongation.

zhOther: 喜普妙, 氫溴酸西酞普蘭
zhHansOther: 喜普妙, 氢溴酸西酞普兰
summaryZh: 西酞普蘭是一種很強的選擇性5-羥色胺再吸收抑制劑型的抗憂鬱藥，其藥物形態為氫溴酸西酞普蘭，商品名為「喜普妙」。在臨床上常用於重性憂鬱疾患、強迫症、恐慌症、社交焦慮症。抗憂鬱效果可能需要1~4周的時間才能顯現。
summaryZhHans: 西酞普兰是一种很强的选择性5-羟色胺再吸收抑制剂型的抗抑郁药，其药物形态为氢溴酸西酞普兰，商品名为“喜普妙”。在临床上常用于重性抑郁障碍、强迫症、惊恐障碍、社交焦虑障碍。抗抑郁效果可能需要1~4周的时间才能显现。

fact.en: Citalopram was first made in 1972 at the Danish company Lundbeck. Its S mirror-image form, which does almost all of the work, was later sold on its own as escitalopram.
fact.zh: 西酞普蘭在 1972 年由丹麥靈北藥廠首次合成。它的 S 型鏡像異構物負責幾乎全部的藥效，後來被單獨製成艾司西酞普蘭販售。
fact.zhHans: 西酞普兰在 1972 年由丹麦灵北药厂首次合成。它的 S 型镜像异构物负责几乎全部的药效，后来被单独制成艾司西酞普兰贩售。
